The '''DH-17 blaster rifle''' was a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] manufactured by [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech Industries]] that resembled BlasTech's [[DH-17 blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] of the same name and its [[DH-17 blaster carbine/Legends|carbine]] variant, albeit with an extended barrel and an added stock. The rifle had two firing modes: fully automatic and a charged-shot mode that was relatively unique for its time.<ref name="BF1 guide" />

It served as a standard service weapon for [[Rebel trooper/Legends|soldiers]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="BF1 guide" /> Prior to the formation of the Alliance, it was the weapon of choice for [[Rahm Kota]]'s [[Kota's Militia|militia]] in their operations against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="TFU" /> In addition, it saw service with the [[Bespin Wing Guard/Legends|Bespin Wing Guard]], the security forces on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]].<ref name="TFU">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]''</ref> An unidentified variant or predecessor of the DH-17 blaster rifle was also used by the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] from the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]] to the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]], and by the [[Temple Security Force]] during [[Operation: Knightfall/Legends|Operation: Knightfall]]. This variant was visually identical to the standard model, but only featured the fully automatic firing mode and fired green blaster bolts instead of red.<ref name="BF1" /><ref name="BF2">''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The DH-17 blaster rifle is the primary weapon for the Rebel soldier in the ''[[Battlefront]]'' [[Star Wars video games|video game]] series. In this role, it is the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance's]] counterpart to the [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper's]] [[E-11 blaster rifle/Legends|E-11 blaster rifle]], the [[clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper's]] [[DC-15A blaster rifle/Legends|DC-15A blaster rifle]], and the [[wrist blaster/Legends|wrist blaster]] and [[E-5 blaster rifle/Legends|E-5 blaster rifle]] of the [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droid]] and [[B1-series battle droid|B1 battle droid]] respectively. Despite this depiction as a standard-issue weapon, it never appears in the [[original trilogy]] and was original to ''[[Star Wars: Battlefront]]'' (2004). Until the release of ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]'' (2008), its appearance remained exclusive to the ''Battlefront'' series.

An unknown variant that fired green blaster bolts was used by the Royal Naboo Security Forces in the Clone Wars campaign of ''Battlefront'' and the Rise of the Empire campaign in ''Battlefront II''. The Temple vanguards during [[Operation: Knightfall/Legends|Operation: Knightfall]] also used this variant.

The name of the blaster is only given in the official strategy guides for ''Battlefront'' and ''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]''. In the [[Star Wars Battlefront: Prima Official Game Guide|former]], it is described as having a "charged-shot mode", but this feature is absent from the actual gameplay. The detail was subsequently removed in the [[Star Wars Battlefront II: Prima Official Game Guide|''Battlefront II'' game guide]].
